question:
For the matrix $A=\begin{bmatrix}2 & -1 & 3\\0 & 4 & 5\\1 & 2 & -2\end{bmatrix}$:

(a) Find the minors $M_{11}$, $M_{12}$, and $M_{13}$.

(b) Obtain the corresponding cofactors $A_{11}$, $A_{12}$, and $A_{13}$.

(c) Using these cofactors, evaluate $|A|$ by expansion along the first row.
explanation:
(a)
Deleting the first row and the respective columns,
$$M_{11}=\begin{vmatrix}4 & 5\\2 & -2\end{vmatrix}=-8-10=-18$$
$$M_{12}=\begin{vmatrix}0 & 5\\1 & -2\end{vmatrix}=0-5=-5$$
$$M_{13}=\begin{vmatrix}0 & 4\\1 & 2\end{vmatrix}=0-4=-4$$

(b)
The cofactor is given by $A_{ij}=(-1)^{i+j}M_{ij}$. Therefore,
$$A_{11}=M_{11}=-18$$
$$A_{12}=-M_{12}=5$$
$$A_{13}=M_{13}=-4$$

(c)
Expanding along the first row,
$$|A|=a_{11}A_{11}+a_{12}A_{12}+a_{13}A_{13}$$
$$|A|=2(-18)+(-1)(5)+3(-4)$$
$$|A|=-36-5-12=-53$$
Hence, $|A|=-53$.
